intro.title: Build a multi step form with validation
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a multi-step form that collects user information across several pages, like a sign-up wizard. You will learn how to manage the form's current step using React state, validate user input before allowing progression, and display helpful error messages. The core concepts involve handling form events, conditional rendering, and implementing validation logic. You'll use React hooks such as useState for state management and basic JavaScript for validation checks, creating a smooth, user-friendly form experience.
intro.usecase: Multi-step forms with validation are a foundational pattern for collecting complex user data in a manageable way. You'll see them in e-commerce checkouts, where they guide users from cart to payment, and in account sign-up flows on platforms like LinkedIn or banking apps, which break profile creation into logical sections. As a developer, implementing this pattern ensures a smooth user experience by validating each step before proceeding, preventing errors and reducing form abandonment. This skill is essential for building any application that requires structured data input, from job application portals to complex configuration wizards in SaaS products.
